maddeler.e:
احتفلا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَلَا (iḥtafalā) /iħ.ta.fa.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# اُحْتُفِلَا (uḥtufilā) /uħ.tu.fi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# اِحْتَفِلَا (iḥtafilā) /iħ.ta.fi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
